settings.sync.title: Bring up to date
settings.sync.body: After a pull request merges: each repository's line is fetched from origin and fast-forwarded, the branches still at work are replayed onto it, only their own commits, and the branches landings made whose work reached it go. Looking fetches; nothing of yours moves until you press, and Daoris never pushes.
settings.sync.nothing: Everything here is up to date.
settings.sync.done: {{changed}} of {{count}} done. What did not happen is still listed, with why.
settings.sync.line.kind.ahead: {{count}} commit `origin/{{line}}` does not have: nothing to pull, and Daoris never pushes.
settings.sync.line.kind.ahead_other: {{count}} commits `origin/{{line}}` does not have: nothing to pull, and Daoris never pushes.
settings.sync.line.kind.diverged: It and `origin/{{line}}` each hold commits the other lacks: only a fast-forward is Daoris's to make.
settings.sync.line.kind.dirty: The repository's own checkout is on it with uncommitted work, so it stays.
settings.sync.line.kind.checkedOut: Checked out in another working tree, which Daoris does not move.
settings.sync.line.kind.noLocal: No local `{{line}}` to move: the line is read from `origin/{{line}}`.
settings.sync.line.kind.noLine: No line is set, and git names none.
settings.sync.line.kind.unknown: Git could not tell, so it stays.
settings.sync.branch.kind.replay: Replays {{count}} commit of its own onto `{{onto}}`.
settings.sync.branch.kind.replay_other: Replays {{count}} commits of its own onto `{{onto}}`.
settings.sync.branch.kind.replayNothing: Moves onto `{{onto}}`: it holds nothing of its own beyond work that reached the line.
settings.sync.branch.after.record: It starts after `{{from}}`'s work, which reached the line.
settings.sync.branch.after.recordUnnamed: It starts after the work it grew from, which reached the line.
settings.sync.branch.after.content: It starts after its newest commit whose work reads on the line.
settings.sync.branch.kind.inUse: A session still running or waiting holds its tree.
settings.sync.branch.kind.checkedOut: Checked out in a working tree that is not a session's own.
settings.sync.branch.kind.pushed: On its remote: replaying it would need a force push.
settings.sync.branch.kind.waits: It grew from `{{from}}`, whose work has not reached the line yet.
settings.sync.branch.kind.waitsUnnamed: It grew from work beyond the line that has not reached it yet.
settings.sync.branch.kind.unknown: Git could not tell, so it stays.
